data.body:
Root cause (cf93b2b7ad): binding_store.save() only wrote bindings.json to the working-tree filesystem. Between reconciler passes, ticket-CLI's _push_tickets_branch() ran 'git merge origin/tickets' which overwrote the un-committed local bindings.json with the GHA-committed remote version, losing Phase-1 probe bindings. Phase-2 reconciler then saw bound tickets as unbound, generated CREATE mutations (dedup-skipped) instead of UPDATE mutations — scalar field edits (title/description/priority/labels/comments) never landed in Jira.

Fix: _commit_binding_store_snapshot() added to reconcile.py, called after binding_store.save(). Commits .bridge_state/bindings.json to the tickets orphan branch so subsequent merges include new bindings. Commit cf93b2b7ad.
